class.name: NNBTUntilFail
class.brief_description: Repeats its child until it fails, then completes with [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS].
class.description: Keeps running its child on every tick while it returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] or [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING], and completes with [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] once the child returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE]. Use for loops that continue doing work until a condition stops holding (such as patrolling waypoints until an enemy is spotted).
